title: DamageDoctor CarDD YOLO Seg
subtitle: CarDD in YOLO segmentation format — polygon masks, 6 damage classes
description: CarDD dataset in YOLO segmentation format with polygon mask labels. 2816 train / 810 val / 374 test images. 6 classes: dent, scratch, crack, glass shatter, lamp broken, tire flat. Labels have polygon coordinates (cls x1 y1 x2 y2 ... xn yn, normalized). Converted from CarDD COCO annotations.
